thesis: Stablecoin headlines provide potential optionality but not measured Visa economics; technicals are weak short term and financial statement dates are missing.
strongest_counterexample: The strongest counterexample is faster-than-expected conversion of stablecoin/agentic-commerce use into network volume, which is not measured in the packet.
invalidation_conditions: A close below the observed 20-bar low would weaken the longer-term stabilization case.
evidence_gaps: No Visa-specific payment volume/revenue data is supplied.
decisive_factors: Price is below SMA-20/50 but above SMA-200.
Dated headlines describe payment adoption, not issuer earnings.
